entities.summary: Raphaël Archenault, known as Raphaël Arnault, is a French far-left activist and politician who has represented Vaucluse's 1st constituency in the National Assembly since 2024. A member of La France Insoumise (LFI), he co-founded the Jeune Garde Antifasciste collective in 2018 and was one of its spokespersons. The collective grew close to LFI before it was outlawed for its violence by the government in 2025. In 2022, Arnault was found guilty of violent behaviour following an assault in 2021.

entities.summary: Raphaël Archenault, known as Raphaël Arnault, is a French far-left activist and politician who has represented Vaucluse's 1st constituency in the National Assembly since 2024. A member of La France Insoumise (LFI), he co-founded the Jeune Garde Antifasciste collective in 2018 and was one of its spokespersons. The collective grew close to LFI before it was outlawed for its violence by the government in 2025. In 2022, Arnault was found guilty of violent behaviour following an assault in 2021.
